Strategy: Combine the count-gated sweet band with a small bonus for nearly exact fits up to five, keeping the mid penalty. This rewards three kinds of good leftovers at once, but the extra bonus may rarely trigger and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (10 if r - item > 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
